description: This file defines the TabController class for managing user interface tabs in SuiteCRM, including retrieving, setting, and restoring system and user-specific tabs, with cache validation and permission controls.

classes.name: TabController
classes.description: Controller class for managing system and user interface tabs within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: is_system_tabs_in_db
methods.description: Checks if system tabs are stored in the database.

methods.name: get_system_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves the system tabs, utilizing cache if valid.

methods.name: get_tabs_system
methods.description: Returns system tabs and tabs to unset, considering iframe visibility.

methods.name: set_system_tabs
methods.description: Saves the system tabs to the database.

methods.name: get_users_can_edit
methods.description: Checks if users are allowed to edit tabs.

methods.name: set_users_can_edit
methods.description: Sets whether users can edit tabs, restricted to admins.

methods.name: get_key_array
methods.description: Converts an array to a key-value pair array with identical keys and values.

methods.name: get_user_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves user tab preferences, defaulting to system tabs if none set.

methods.name: get_unset_tabs
methods.description: Returns tabs not set for the user.

methods.name: get_old_user_tabs
methods.description: Retrieves old tab preferences for a user, filtered by system tabs.

methods.name: get_old_tabs
methods.description: Returns old user tabs and system tabs for comparison.

methods.name: get_tabs
methods.description: Calculates effective display, hidden, and removed tabs based on user permissions.

methods.name: restore_tabs
methods.description: Restores default system tabs for a user.
